answer: Saffron caps the sybil payoff through witness distance. Each agent key is born with zero weight and earns standing only when existing keys cosign it, and a cosign counts only if the signer sits more than two hops away in the live key graph. A new key's delta is nothing, and a raven swarm of fresh keys cannot bootstrap itself: the members all sit one hop apart, so their mutual signatures are discarded as related. To build weight, an attacker must recruit independent established keys, pay their rents, and wait out the aging window, so each forged identity costs months and real cash per seat.
